question: What invulnerability is gained in relation to the weapons of all beings?
premises: All beings are included in scope.
Weapons and missiles are named as threats.
A resulting state is indicated by jāyate.
inference: One becomes invulnerable to the weapons and missiles of all beings.
uncertainties: The subject and exact predicate are compressed and rely on context.
plain_english: One becomes unaffected by the weapons and missiles of all beings.
